summary.name: CodexBar
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source macOS menu bar app that tracks usage windows, credit balances, and reset countdowns across 110 AI coding providers.
use_cases: Check remaining Codex or Claude Code usage without logging in
See when AI tool session and weekly limits reset
Monitor credit balances across multiple AI providers
Run usage checks from scripts or CI
Track monthly spend on AI APIs
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a macOS menu bar app that shows per-provider session, weekly, and monthly usage windows with countdowns to the next reset. It displays credit balances and monthly spend where providers expose them, and can run configurable local cost scans for Codex and Claude. A bundled codexbar command-line binary prints the same usage output for scripts, CI, and terminal checks. Provider status polling shows incident badges in the menu and an overlay on the bar icon. It reuses existing provider sessions (OAuth, device flow, API keys, browser cookies, local files) and states that no passwords are stored.
notable: Covers about 110 AI providers, including OpenAI Codex, Claude, Cursor, Gemini, and Copilot
Bundled codexbar CLI plus standalone tarballs for macOS and Linux
Reuses existing sessions and states no passwords are stored on disk
caveats: Requires Full Disk Access for Safari cookies and Keychain access for cookie decryption and OAuth flows
Provider support varies: some only expose usage through cookies, API keys, or local files
